findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional — `merged_before_weeks` changes its search cutoff each Monday, but `prs-older-cache` retains Sunday's result for 24 hours. A task merged in the week that just fell outside the six-week window is absent from both the weekly lists and the cached older list. During that interval, the board loses its part history and `forge next` can treat the merged part as unmerged. The named lifetime test advances from Wednesday to Thursday, so it does not catch this transition.

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done — The warm-command test checks that the `gh` stub received no calls, but it only counts Git commands; it never checks whether any were network calls. In a client repo with a Dockerfile on the default branch, the unchanged `nextstep._needs_demo_address` path calls `repo.default_config`, which runs `git fetch origin <default>` on every `forge next --json`, including a warm run. Neither tested client fixture has a Dockerfile, so the proof passes while the stated no-network condition fails for this common layout.
